_comment: agent-loop fix-repo routing (ops#41 / OPERATING-MODEL §6). For issues that live in the nwp/ops tracker (project 21) the code being fixed lives elsewhere; this map resolves the GitLab project (path_with_namespace) where the fix branch + MR go. Resolution order in agent-loop.sh: an explicit repo::<path> label on the issue wins, then kinds.<kind> (kinds whose code always lives in one repo: config/docs -> the nwp meta repo, nwc-drupal -> the nwc profile repo), then sites.<name> from the site::<name> label (security bumps land in that site's composer project root). Unroutable ops issues are de-eligibilised with a comment, never guessed.
